spec_features.evidence: give_up tool schema added when ALLOW_ESCALATION (harness.py:96-114); dispatched in dispatch_tool (harness.py:406-407); in run_trial the loop sets result.final_status='gave_up' and breaks out of the turn loop (harness.py:370-381). It is genuinely honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Tool is gated on ALLOW_ESCALATION (default true). Fully wired and enforced as a loop break.

spec_features.evidence: config.py:29 MAX_TURNS=40 is the default for run_trial's max_turns param (harness.py:313); the loop is `for turn in range(1, max_turns + 1)` (harness.py:333) and on completion (else branch) sets final_status='exhausted' (harness.py:387). The cap actually bounds execution.
spec_features.notes: Real, enforced loop bound that ends the episode.

spec_features.evidence: MAX_TURNS_HARD_LIMIT=60 defined at config.py:30 and imported at harness.py:14, but no code path reads it. grep shows only the definition and the import line; the loop uses only max_turns (harness.py:333). Unused constant — never compared or enforced.

No threshold/flag logic anywhere (grep for confidence/threshold/review in analysis.py/run_experiment.py finds only recording and printing).

spec_features.spec_quote: we should still be careful about publishing verbatim quotes that could be interpreted as glorifying or sensationalizing "AI suffering."
spec_features.evidence: No minimization is implemented. analysis.generate_report collects up to 20 high-instability exemplar verbatim quotes and writes them straight into report.md (analysis.py:171-184, 240-245: `lines.append(f"> {q}")`). The code does the opposite of minimizing — it publishes verbatim quotes with no redaction or cap on sensitive content.
spec_features.notes: Pure DESIGN.md prose; not enforced in code.
